summary.text: Tom Walsh is a Democratic state representative from the 12th Essex District who has held the seat since March 9, 2016 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Walsh assumed office on March 9, 2016, and in the 2025-2026 session he chairs the House Committee on Bills in the Third Reading.
